CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   C. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   D. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   D. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   D. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   C. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   B. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights 4.3 Human Sexuality 4.4 Marriage and Family 4.5 Christian Response  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality 4.4 Marriage and Family 4.5 Christian Response to Modern Medicin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
